segments.name: Activated Carbon Technologies
segments.description: Provides patented activated carbon technologies for mercury emissions capture at coal-fired power plants and developing water purification solutions targeting PFAS.
segments.evidence: We are a provider of specialty activated carbon technologies, delivering innovative solutions for air and water purification.

revenueModel.text: Coal-fired utilities and licensees pay for sorbent products, patent licenses, demonstrations, consulting services and equipment.
